sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 per unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your proposal for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our current Angebot consists of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We have carefully reviewed your offer, but we cannot accommodate further price reductions for the requested 90-day payment terms and 36-month contract. We take pride in supporting your business with our dedicated service and comprehensive range, and we are keen to keep you as a valued customer.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our price of €4.94 remains firm for this package.

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

This offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
